local_replay_caps.case_unit: one anchor-hit prediction on a bound source/site/input/factor/cache tuple; not NFE or independent source
local_replay_caps.fixed_numeric_module_definition: selected family r1408, 2 neutral sources x 2 experts x layer19 x 2 cache modes x 2 FP32/TF32 settings; losslessly raise fixed native BF16 anchors/operand/factor values to FP32; execute delta-u/delta-h/GELU/cache-add and 2R anchor projections/subtractions in FP32, final cast BF16, same F64 risk; no FP32 model/anchor regeneration or factor refit
local_replay_caps.local_target: own-W native BF16 P512 anchor/hit reconstruction; full-M panel target separately named and quantified

candidate_intermediate_cache.purpose: Preserve actual main BF16 hhat/Yhat before selection; avoid later prediction recomputation
candidate_intermediate_cache.retention: Drop nonselected large candidate tensors after selection/decomposition; retain all scores/identity and needed main intermediates

local_replay_caps.error_decomposition_arithmetic: Losslessly raise actual BF16 values to F64 before subtraction; two B2 factor actions per case (132 actions, 264 factor GEMMs); E_num defined as residual, closure checked at F64 rounding scale and not independent mechanism validation.

dense_capture.persistent_auxiliary: P512 native targets/current gates, fixed64 row identities, raster/grid/voxel identities, bounded selector traces

superseded_5a5_bound.new_explicit_component: mandatory CAL3 VAE/text adaptation diagnostics <=30 model calls

freeze_rule: Native Dense/neutral captures may precede freeze; main family/parameters/CAL22 and E5/E6 choices use preset local criteria and freeze before any new approximate-arm free-video outputs.
statistics_unit: source/near-duplicate cluster; report actual cluster count, not token/layer/frame count
